vision.body1: Incorporated in Mumbai on 13 December 1978 by {{founder}}, Amma Lines grew from a pioneering marine construction company into the flagship of the Meka Group. Over four decades, we have delivered most of India's major breakwaters — including the longest, at Tuticorin Port — along with landmark jetties, deepwater dredging and reclamation works.
vision.body2: Our works are delivered by our own engineers, crews and fleet under an ISO-certified QHSE management system. Dredging is now executed primarily through our sister company, Meka Dredging.

feature.narrative1: Amma Lines delivered the north and south breakwaters at Karaikal Port — 1,300 metres of armoured coastline — together with 666,500 m³ of capital dredging. The works were executed as an integrated marine scope for Karaikal Port.

expertise.subtitle: Six of twelve disciplines

about.title: Flagship of the Meka Group
about.ledeBody: Amma Lines Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated on 13 December 1978 by {{founder}} in Mumbai. From a pioneering marine construction firm, it has grown into the flagship of the Meka Group — delivering world-class marine infrastructure, coastal protection and port development across India and international waters.
about.valuesBody: Not values on a wall — these are decisions we make every day, at the site and in the office.

services.title: Twelve Disciplines, In-House
services.ledeBody: Every discipline below is delivered by our own engineers, crews and fleet. We do not mediate marine works.
services.ctaHeadlineItalic: Let us walk the site with you.

breakwater-construction.title: Breakwater Construction
breakwater-construction.body: A forty-year legacy in breakwater construction — including the longest breakwaters in India, at Tuticorin Port. Rubble-mound, armoured and guide-bund structures engineered to dissipate tidal surge and protect working harbours.

piling.title: Piling
piling.body: Piling solutions that form the backbone of strong, sustainable marine and civil structures — driven and bored, engineered for challenging soils and coastal conditions.

sheet-piling.title: Sheet Piling
sheet-piling.body: Sheet piling for marine and coastal infrastructure — engineered for earth retention and water control in challenging environments: cofferdams, bund walls, quays.

pile-jetties.title: Pile Jetties
pile-jetties.body: Pile jetties serve several marine needs — from LNG jetties to container berths. The multi-use advantages make it the go-to technology for most modern marine construction.

block-jetties.title: Block Jetties
block-jetties.body: Robust block jetties designed for long-lasting stability and support in coastal environments — constructed with durable pre-cast concrete blocks, placed underwater to the millimetre.

ro-ro-jetties.title: RO-RO Jetties
ro-ro-jetties.body: With cargo becoming more versatile, Roll-on / Roll-off jetties are used for everything from cars and buses to ODC (Over-Dimensional Cargo) packages. Ramps engineered for tidal range and vessel draft.

cofferdam-construction.title: Cofferdam Construction
cofferdam-construction.body: Cofferdams are vital temporary works — watertight enclosures that protect construction equipment and crews, giving a dry, stable working environment below sea level.

caisson-construction.title: Caisson Construction
caisson-construction.body: A caisson is a large watertight retaining structure used in marine works — from bridge-pier foundations to port construction and concrete-dam works. Floated, sunk and sealed to grade.

well-sinking.title: Well Sinking
well-sinking.body: Similar to caissons, well sinking differs by being open at the bottom — used primarily in bridges and pier construction where foundation soils are deep.

dredging.title: Dredging
dredging.body: One of our original strengths. Deepwater works are now executed primarily through our sister company, Meka Dredging — but we continue to deliver dredging as part of our integrated marine scope.

soil-improvement.title: Soil Improvement
soil-improvement.body: Soil improvement covers many disciplines — on land and underwater. We deploy vibro-compaction, stone columns, preloading and other techniques to prepare seabeds for decades of service.

technical-services.title: Technical Services & Solutions
technical-services.body: Decades of engineering and innovation in marine and hydraulic environments. Bathymetric surveys, geotechnical investigation, condition assessments, feasibility studies and construction management for owners, authorities and EPC contractors.

01.title: Quality Construction
01.body: Every project is delivered to global engineering standards — durable, safe, inspected, and built to last in the harshest marine environments.

02.title: Mutual Partnership
02.body: Long-term collaborations with owners, EPC contractors and authorities — built on absolute trust, transparent reporting, and shared accountability.

03.title: Proactive Safety
03.body: An ISO-certified QHSE management system. Safety is the measure of engineering, not a box to be ticked at hand-over.

04.title: Teamwork
04.body: Collaboration, innovation and excellence through skilled crews, modern equipment and hands-on leadership — the same teams, year after year.

1978.title: Foundation
1978.body: Incorporated on 13 December 1978 by Dr. Meka Papa Rao, as the pioneering marine construction company that would become the flagship of the Meka Group.

1988.title: Floating Breakwater, JNPT
1988.body: The 650-metre floating breakwater (guide-bund) at Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Navi Mumbai — the firm's first landmark marine work.

1990.title: Elephanta Island Jetty
1990.body: The 560-metre passenger jetty at Elephanta Island, Mumbai Harbour.

1999.title: Ennore Port
1999.body: Four kilometres of breakwaters at Ennore Port, Tamil Nadu.

2009.title: Karaikal Port
2009.body: 1,300 metres of north & south breakwaters and 666,500 m³ of dredging at Karaikal Port, Puducherry.

2024.title: ETInfra Awards
2024.body: Recognised by The Economic Times ETInfra Awards for Best Infrastructure Company — Marine Industry (Small Cap) and Excellence in Transportation Infrastructure — Marine.

hmr.bio: Mechanical Engineer, Georgia Institute of Technology, USA. Leads the practice with a focus on innovative, cost-effective marine solutions — elevating a family legacy that began in 1978.

basu.bio: Thirty-five-plus years of expertise in HDPE pipeline installation, heavy marine infrastructure and EPC-project delivery. Oversees technical execution across all active sites.

rayudu.bio: Forty-plus years of specialised experience in large-scale dredging operations and marine infrastructure. Directs the fleet and the firm's approach to weather-window planning.
